items.title: Windows 11 KB5124008 Update Breaks Active Directory Domain Trust and Blocks User Logins
items.description: Microsoft is investigating reports that the Windows 11 KB5124008 security update is breaking Active Directory domain trust on some enterprise computers, leaving users unable to sign in with valid credentials. The problem appears linked to Machine Identity Isolation, although Microsoft has not confirmed the root cause or published an official workaround. Released on September 8, […] The post…

items.title: ZDI-CAN-33991: Foxit
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Anonymous' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-09-16, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2027-01-14 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
